meta.title: Day 1 of 5: The Glowing Stairwell, the Tutorial Zones, and the First Saferooms
meta.summary: Floor 1 timed playthrough, Day 1 of 5, cold start: the party walks down a glowing surface stairwell inside the one-hour entrance window, becomes Crawlers on the first step onto Floor 1, and plays the tutorial line (Z0 to Z5) to the Z6 Break Room, then on toward the Z9 Green Room. Nothing collapses (tutorial pace). Three routes to the stairwell (dash, loot, clever) are laid out with eleven encounters, a Stairwell key findable three ways, loot and achievement hooks from existing decks and tables, and a stall fallback. CR, budget, credit and loot figures are cited from rules/70-encounter-budget-5e.json by field path (GM-adaptable guideline). A shared template: no live party is assumed.

collapse_miss.text: Any Crawler not at a stairwell when the floor collapses is dead, and all Crawlers still on the floor die with it. There is no Reprieve, no toll and no detour for it. Death and revival follow Core Book Ch1, Death and Revival: death is permanent, Costly Revives are the default (rare and expensive), and a Replacement Crawler is the usual outcome. Per decision 028 (tagged inspired): the dead Crawler's credits and items are destroyed with the floor; surviving party members may loot the body only while the floor still stands, and anything taken before the collapse is theirs. NPCs and the AI go into stasis and lose nothing.

day.stall_fallback: At the top of the stairs the one-hour entrance window does the work: the System counts it down, and anyone still on the surface when it closes is a Native, not a Crawler (canon M-539, M-541, M-545); that player rolls a fresh Crawler who joins at the next saferoom (Core Book Ch1, Death and Revival, Replacement Crawler). Once inside, Day 1 has no collapse, so stalling only costs clock. If the party loiters in the Atrium, Proctor Bell sells hints until they try the shutter (enc-d01-07). If they loiter in the Break Room, the System posts Short Rest and Long Rest reminders, the corkboard rumors repeat, and the Lights-Out hour arrives on schedule (enc-d01-04). If they refuse to pick a route, the vending terminal offers the bribe in enc-d01-01 and the speaker announces what the clock will do tomorrow. If the day rolls over at the 24-hour mark without a Long Rest, the System still posts the Day 2 notice; the party simply rests later at an honest saferoom. The Floor 1 Reprieve does not cover a missed collapse: that is death on every floor (decision 026), so say so at the start.
day.start_note: Cold start (Caleb, 2026-10-05): the table begins on the surface at a glowing stairwell with the one-hour entrance window running, and each character becomes a Crawler on the first step onto Floor 1, in the Intake Hall (Z0; canon M-547). Intake runs in the booths: registration and paperwork first, then character creation (00-overview.md sections 1 and 5.0). Day 1 then runs the tutorial line, Z1 to Z5, to the Break Room (Z6, the first saferoom and the Welcome Boxes), and on through Z8 (Z7 optional) to the Green Room (Z9), where the default Long Rest closes the day. A Long Rest taken in the Break Room also closes Day 1, and Day 2 then starts there. Play order is the order on this page; encounter ids keep their earlier numbers so later pages still point at them. The floor clock starts when the surface entrances open, at the horn and the light beams (Syndicate, 2026-10-05): floor hour 0 is that moment, and the one-hour entrance window runs inside floor hours 0 to 1. This page is a shared template: a saved campaign resuming mid-floor starts from its own session files, not from this cold open.

rest_options.note: The first saferoom on the floor, where the Welcome Boxes are opened. Honest saferoom through Day 3; it stops being a saferoom when it loses service on Day 4 (decision 026). A Long Rest here ends Day 1 early.
Honest saferoom; open to the end of the floor (inspired). The default Long Rest that closes Day 1 and brings level 2.

A field rest can only be a Short Rest (Core Book Ch1, The Floor Clock and Saferooms: Long Rests only in saferooms). The rest-without-a-saferoom price (rules/70-encounter-budget-5e.json#floors.1.prices.rest_without_saferoom) buys a quiet Short Rest and grants no Long Rest; unpaid or noisy, Ceiling Ticks interrupt it (00-overview.md section 2 rule 7). A saferoom is where the day's Long Rest happens (the Break Room through Day 3, the Green Room always). GM ruling: no fee if the spot is already quiet. A Short Rest in a place that is already quiet is free; the fee only buys quiet where the area is not (for example the dark halls on Days 4 and 5).

If someone stands at the edge of open pavement to gawk, the System can open a stairwell under them and drop them in (canon M-548): house call, tagged inspired, they land in the Intake Hall winded and embarrassed, never hurt. Never a wipe.
